question.text: What style of options are exchange-traded interest rate options (IROs) in India?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the ETIRD workbook (pp.153-154), the IRO contract specification lists premium-style European Call and Put Options for exchange-traded interest rate options, exercisable only on the expiration date. The Trap: American style (exercisable any time), Bermudan, and Asian styles do not match the IRO contract specification for exchange-traded options in India. Note: Anchor the answer to the IRO contract specification on pp.153-154; comparisons to other option markets are not part of this source basis.
